main_stages.title: Crumb Crossing
main_stages.goal: Shrink a blocking sugar cube, carry a teaspoon through a narrow handle, and enlarge it across a saucer gap.

valid_solution.status: verified through source and packaged native ordinary-input routes; 10 checks each
steps: Shrink the blocking sugar cube to its authored small scale 0.35 and walk through the paper tray side passage to checkpoint 1.
Shrink the teaspoon to 0.5, pick it up, and carry it through the narrow cup handle.
Place the teaspoon between the saucers, stand clear, and enlarge it to scale 2 to reach the bridge-ready checkpoint 2.
Walk across the real enlarged spoon bridge to the far saucer.
Optionally greet the crumb friends, then approach the teal flag to complete the stage and save its earned clear and completed snapshot atomically.
valid_solution.payoff: The enlarged spoon visibly spans the saucer gap; the flag triggers a brief Pip celebration and replay/workshop choices.

alternate_routes.status: optional reactions implemented; alternate required solution not authored
routes: Optional crumb greeting and nearby pinwheel reaction do not gate completion.

main_stages.title: Blueberry Ballast
main_stages.goal: Enlarge blueberries and roll them onto a cereal-box flap; shrink one to balance the rising cardboard ramp.

valid_solution.status: source and final packaged ordinary-input routes verified; 10 checks each
steps: Enlarge berry_a and use interact to roll it along its authored channel into the first cereal-flap pocket.
Enlarge berry_b and roll it into the second pocket; the two large berries over-raise the ramp.
While Pip is clear of the mechanism, shrink either seated berry to Small; the Small/Large pair aligns the ramp with the landing.
Walk the aligned ramp, optionally inspect the exposed counterweights, and reach the teal flag.
Save earned completion and the completed stage snapshot together; return through the workshop or replay.
valid_solution.payoff: The exposed weight stack, flap and cardboard ramp move visibly together; reducing either berry brings the landing into alignment.

alternate_routes.status: both symmetric solutions verified through native ordinary input

valid_solution.status: verified through source and exported native input replay
steps: Shrink the spoon, carry it through the cup handle, place it in its suggested rest, and enlarge it into a bridge.

Carry the small butter pat to its wedge socket and enlarge it to latch the ramp and open a permanent return route.
Remove and reuse the blueberry; the latched ramp remains safe.
Place the napkin in the landing zone and enlarge it.
Use the blueberry to depress the toaster lever, board the lowered toast, then shrink the blueberry from the intended target distance.
Follow the controlled toast flight through the cereal-box window to the prepared napkin and matchbox flag.
